scope: Synthetic qualification only. No Voynich feature values or held-out sign scores.
source: Wright 1934 English extract, PDF63-64 / printed62-63, sections457-458; one textual witness, two visual readbacks by same agent.
transcription: Consecutive run lengths. Star=F in457; unstarred=M. In458 normalize dark/shadowed glyph to s and luminous to L. Adjacent identical runs preserved; Aries third458 run d8 confirmed enlarged. All24 rows sum30.
geometry: Aries/Taurus10+5 per panel; Gemini16+9+5 extra; Cancer12+11+7. Pisces29 and uncertain Leo excluded. Six binary traversal alternatives and common30 phases; no per-sign fitting.
search: All1920 traversals/phases x16 templates (457 binary;458 fifteen nontrivial binary partitions up to complement). Absolute within-panel/ring centered correlation. Exact duplicate template rows deduplicated. Search maximum recomputed in every null.
null: 199 independent within-ring cyclic shifts; rotate missingness with values. Block means and norms recomputed on observed slots. Monte Carlo p=(1+#null>=observed)/200; conservative tie tolerance1e-7. Bonferroni2 reserves garment/enclosure feature family. Pigment unavailable; labels not scored.
qualification: 40 replicates per regime; each negative <=4/40 flags at adjustedp<=.05; clean >=36/40; noisy10%flip15%missing >=32/40. ALL gates required. Report Wilson intervals; no tuning/retries within v85.
confirmation: Qualification alone does not authorize manuscript scoring. Future development selects one global rule, freezes it, and predicts whole held-out signs without refitting. Current held-out signs untouched. No mapping of table sex to figure sex asserted.
limitations: Same-agent source transcription, not independent witness; synthetic sample geometry only, not empirical ambiguity masks. Two features Bonferroni protected. Null assumes within-ring rotational exchangeability; shared layout nuisance explicitly challenges it.
